name: Thumb Carpometacarpal Joint Dislocation
definition: Traumatic dislocation of the first carpometacarpal joint, an uncommon injury that may cause persistent instability if not recognized.

investigations.principle: Radiographs define dislocation and exclude fracture; CT is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent instability may require ligament repair or temporary fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Angushtha-Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented after modern care.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic dislocation of the first carpometacarpal joint, an uncommon injury that may cause persistent instability if not recognized.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
